fetch_openml_mnist: fetch the MNIST 784 dataset using fetch_openml with return_X_y=True and as_frame=False
train_mlpclassifier: train an MLPClassifier on MNIST with 40 hidden units, SGD solver, and 8 iterations
split_train_test: split the MNIST dataset into training and test partitions using train_test_split with 0.7 test size
visualize_mlp_weights: visualize the first-layer weights of a trained MLPClassifier as 28x28 grayscale images
evaluate_mlp_classifier: evaluate a trained MLPClassifier on training and test sets using the score method
